title: GravityMachine
description: Adjust and manipulate gravity levels with custom keybinds and configurable settings!
body:
![gravity banner :/](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/93910c9eb4478ae89e67f889d232ed139b301abc.jpeg)

## GravityMachine!
**GravityMachine** is a **mod** that lets you adjust vanilla Minecraft's gravity attributes and allows you to have fun with the gravity changing! This is also my first Fabric (and Quilt) mod to be released and however, is very different from my usual plugins. It can detect if the mod is being used on the server as well, if it is not on the server it will be disabled due to a possiblity of being flagged as cheating.

This mod works on client-side (singleplayer) and server-side (multiplayer) so that you can enjoy it with your friends or, all alone! This mod also works on multiple **different** languages! English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Swedish and Russian are all supported! However, not everything will be translated but most labels will be. Some dialects are not supported due to the amount Minecraft can have and the fact that generalized languages won't work (requires the dialect type).

### Integrations and dependencies
If your using GravityMachine on Fabric, you will have to install the Fabric API. If your using GravityMachine on Quilt, you will have to use [QFAPI/QSL](https://modrinth.com/mod/qsl) to use it or it will fail to load on Quilt. Both are 100% required, depending on your platform.

GravityMachine supports [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) and [Cloth Config](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config) to be used to configure it's settings. Now these aren't fully required but if you want to change the default values, you will have to install **both** to use it. I highly recommend you install both!

### Platforms & versions
Now unfortunately, unlike my plugins, only 1.21.6 (which is the version I use) is supported due to the amount of programming it would take to reach a range from at least 1.21.11 - 1.16.5. However this mod works on Fabric AND it's fork, Quilt. 

GravityMachine works on Fabric and also Quilt but like I said, you will need their respective APIs.The versioning system on GravityMachine and any other future Fabric mods is slightly different from the normal system due to being forced into using ```x.x.x``` instead of ```x.xx.x```.

Dont expect any new versions.
